summary: component-manifest leftover-join.v15 is a clean successor to the dual-REJECTED v14. It lands all three of my frozen v14 findings and all three deliberately unlabeled Codex v14 findings, and it does so in the bytes rather than only in its own prose — which is the precise failure that made v14 a REJECT. The landing ledger, the half CLAUDE-CMLJ-V14-B1 and the second Codex MUST-FIX existed to protect, is now extended rather than merely carried: lands grew 17 to 23 and findingDisposition 17 to 29, absorbing both the v13 backlog that v14 claimed but never recorded and this version's own six landings, with every unlabeled Codex finding dispositioned by verbatim title under identifierMintedByThisLineage false. The adjacency label was re-based rather than copied: 'Immediate frozen predecessor' now sits once, on predecessorV14, with explicit non-adjacency denials on v12 and v13 — the artifact avoided the symmetrical error of applying a v14-scoped repair verbatim, and says so in purpose. A full flattened key diff against frozen v14 shows 95 additions, zero removals and 36 changes, of which 28 are mechanical self-token bumps and 8 are exactly the repair sites the six findings named; no digest, verdict transcription, partition member, obligation flag or recording token moved. Independent re-derivation confirms required-now 28 from file 08's own gate rows, the four-member leftoverDesign partition from the obligations array rather than from summary, all 57 recordedInputs pins and all 58 basedOn path-sha pairs, the DR-103 OPEN token, the D-311 heading tail and both custody digests. Zero unstemmed prose tokens, zero deictics, zero invented identifiers, no SATISFIED or QUALIFIED claim. The sharpest attacks — a claimed landing unsupported by bytes, a digest mutated under cover of the repairs, a doesNot member dropped during insertion, and the apparent clash between D-293's OD-1 owner assignment and file 08's still-UNASSIGNED cell — were each pursued to source and killed; the last fails because the artifact itself discloses the divergence and marks the register echo owed at a later MF-6, which I verified verbatim against file 08 line 285.
